This project started as a commercial campaign with a clear message: sustainability isn’t optional; it’s essential. But life had other plans. A supply shortage sidelined the original idea, and new stakeholders decided to head in a different direction.

What did we do? We refused to let this work disappear. Every scene, every detail, every ounce of care we poured into this deserved a purpose. So we flipped the script. We rewrote the story, removed the product, and gifted it to nonprofits fighting for bee conservation. It wasn’t about salvaging effort; it was about using art to amplify action.
The final piece became a love letter to bees and the ecosystems they sustain—a vibrant reminder that meaningful work doesn’t need a brand attached to matter.

What started as a difficult product announcement became a story about something much more human: letting go of what we know and finding something new on the other side.

const config = {
	intersectionOffset: 0.2,
	intersectionOnce: true,
	progressOffset: 0,
	progressOnce: false
};

function setupAnimation({ trigger, selector, offset, once }) {
	const isProgressBased = trigger === 'progress';

	return enterView({
		selector,
		enter: el => !isProgressBased && toggleClasses(el, 'in', 'out'),
		exit: el => !isProgressBased && toggleClasses(el, 'out', 'in'),
		progress: (el, progress) => isProgressBased && animateProgress(el, progress),
		offset,
		once
	});
}

function toggleClasses(el, addClass, removeClass) {
	el.classList.add(addClass);
	el.classList.remove(removeClass);
}

function animateProgress(el, progress) {
	el.style.opacity = progress;
	el.style.transform = getProgressTransform(el, progress);
}

function getProgressTransform(el, progress) {
	const parent = el.parentElement;
	const dataAniProgress = parent && parent.hasAttribute('data-ani-progress')
    	? parent.getAttribute('data-ani-progress')
    	: el.getAttribute('data-ani-progress');

	const offset = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).getPropertyValue('--ani-slide-offset')) || 0;
	const rotate = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).getPropertyValue('--ani-flip-rotate')) || 0;
	const scale = 1 - (1 - progress) * (1 - parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).getPropertyValue('--ani-zoom-out-scale')) || 1);

	switch (dataAniProgress) {
		case 'slide-up': return `translateY(${(1 - progress) * offset}px)`;
		case 'slide-down': return `translateY(-${(1 - progress) * offset}px)`;
		case 'slide-left': return `translateX(${(1 - progress) * offset}px)`;
		case 'slide-right': return `translateX(-${(1 - progress) * offset}px)`;
		case 'flip-x': return `rotateX(${(1 - progress) * rotate}deg)`;
		case 'flip-y': return `rotateY(${(1 - progress) * rotate}deg)`;
		case 'zoom': return `scale(${scale})`;

	setupAnimation({
		trigger: 'intersection',
		selector: triggerEls,

	setupAnimation({
		trigger: 'progress',
		selector: triggerElsProgress,
		offset: config.progressOffset,
		once: config.progressOnce
	});

        const xRotationMax = parseFloat(card.getAttribute('x-rotation-max')) || 10;
        const yRotationMax = parseFloat(card.getAttribute('y-rotation-max')) || 10;
        let isHovering = false;

        function setRotation(event) {
            if (!isHovering) return;

            const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
            const centerX = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
            const centerY = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
            const mouseX = event.clientX - centerX;
            const mouseY = event.clientY - centerY;

            const rotateY = gsap.utils.clamp(-xRotationMax, xRotationMax, (mouseX / centerX) * xRotationMax);
            const rotateX = gsap.utils.clamp(-yRotationMax, yRotationMax, -(mouseY / centerY) * yRotationMax);

            gsap.set(card, {
                rotateY,
                rotateX
            });
        }

        card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
            isHovering = true;
        });

        card.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
            isHovering = false;
            gsap.to(card, {
                rotateY: 0,
                rotateX: 0,
                duration: 0.5,
                delay: 0.2,
                ease: "power2.out"
            });
        });

        card.addEventListener('mousemove', setRotation);
    });

  import Lenis from 'https://esm.run/lenis'
  import Snap from 'https://esm.run/lenis/snap'

  const lenis = new Lenis({
    duration: 1.2,

  function createSnap() {
    // Destroy previous instance if it exists
    if (snap) snap.destroy()

    snap = new Snap(lenis, {
      type: 'mandatory',
      velocityThreshold: 1,
    })

    document.querySelectorAll('.snap-anchor').forEach((el) => {
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect()
      const scrollTop = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop
      const centerOffset = scrollTop + rect.top + el.offsetHeight / 2 - window.innerHeight / 2
      snap.add(centerOffset)
    })
  }

  window.addEventListener('load', createSnap)

  // Debounce resize to avoid thrashing
  let resizeTimer
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    clearTimeout(resizeTimer)
    resizeTimer = setTimeout(createSnap, 1000)
  })

  function raf(time) {
    lenis.raf(time)
    requestAnimationFrame(raf)
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(raf)

            const progress = video.currentTime / video.duration;
            progressFill.style.transform = `scaleX(${progress})`;
        }
    }

    function seek(e) {
        if (!video.duration) return;
        const bar = progressBar || progressFill.parentElement;
        const rect = bar.getBoundingClientRect();
        const clickX = e.clientX - rect.left;
        const ratio = Math.min(Math.max(clickX / rect.width, 0), 1);
        video.currentTime = ratio * video.duration;
    }

    toggleButton.addEventListener("click", togglePlay);

    // Make progress bar clickable — use the track element if available, else fall back to progressFill
    const seekTarget = progressBar || progressFill.parentElement;
    seekTarget.addEventListener("click", seek);

    let isScrubbing = false;
    seekTarget.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
        isScrubbing = true;
        seek(e);
    });
    document.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {

    });

            }
        });
    }

    video.addEventListener("timeupdate", updateProgress);
    updateUI();
});
</script>

<script type="module">
const containers = document.querySelectorAll(".video-player-container");
containers.forEach(container => {
    const video = container.querySelector(".film");
    const toggleButton = container.querySelector(".toggleButton");
    const fullscreenButton = container.querySelector(".fullscreenButton");
    const progressFill = container.querySelector(".progressFill");
    const progressBar = container.querySelector(".progressBar");

    async function togglePlay(e) {
        if (e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
        }

        if (video.paused || video.ended) {
            try {
                await video.play();
            } catch (err) {
                console.error("Playback blocked:", err);
            }
        } else {
            video.pause();
        }
    }

    function updateUI() {
        if (video.paused) {
            // The SVG stays untouched inside the button now
            toggleButton.style.opacity = "1";
            toggleButton.style.pointerEvents = "auto"; 
            toggleButton.style.visibility = "visible";
        } else {
            toggleButton.style.opacity = "0";
            toggleButton.style.pointerEvents = "none"; 
            toggleButton.style.visibility = "hidden";
        }
    }

    function updateProgress() {
        if (video.duration) {
            const progress = video.currentTime / video.duration;
            progressFill.style.transform = `scaleX(${progress})`;
        }
    }

    function seek(e) {
        if (!video.duration) return;
        const bar = progressBar || progressFill.parentElement;
        const rect = bar.getBoundingClientRect();
        const clientX = e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX;
        const clickX = clientX - rect.left;
        const ratio = Math.min(Math.max(clickX / rect.width, 0), 1);
        video.currentTime = ratio * video.duration;
    }

    toggleButton.addEventListener("click", togglePlay);
    toggleButton.addEventListener("touchstart", togglePlay, { passive: false });

    video.addEventListener("click", togglePlay);
    video.addEventListener("touchstart", togglePlay, { passive: false });

    const seekTarget = progressBar || progressFill.parentElement;
    seekTarget.addEventListener("click", seek);
    seekTarget.addEventListener("touchstart", seek, { passive: true });

    let isScrubbing = false;
    seekTarget.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
        isScrubbing = true;
        seek(e);
    });
    document.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
        if (isScrubbing) seek(e);
    });
    document.addEventListener("mouseup", () => {
        isScrubbing = false;
    });

    if (fullscreenButton) {
        const handleFullscreen = (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            if (video.webkitEnterFullscreen) {
                video.webkitEnterFullscreen();
            } else if (container.requestFullscreen) {
                if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
                    container.requestFullscreen().catch(err => console.warn(err));
                } else {
                    document.exitFullscreen();
                }
            }
        };
        fullscreenButton.addEventListener("click", handleFullscreen);
        fullscreenButton.addEventListener("touchstart", handleFullscreen, { passive: false });
    }

    video.addEventListener("play", updateUI);
    video.addEventListener("pause", updateUI);
    video.addEventListener("timeupdate", updateProgress);
    
    updateUI();
});
</script>
